scope: Exploratory: holdouts and tuned results were inspected before these baselines were chosen. Intervals are paired source-group percentile intervals conditional on fixed checkpoints, without multiplicity correction. Zero-shot baselines decode up to 320 tokens; structured checkpoints 120, describe checkpoints 320.
prevalence_note: PPV(pi) = r pi / (r pi + (1 - v)(1 - pi)) with invalid recall r and valid retention v held fixed; assumes recall and retention transfer unchanged to a population with invalid prevalence pi.
